title: Include decoder Kraus outputs in an exact two-design memory test
statement: For each of six logical Pauli eigenstates, construct pass/fail bath Kraus operators using the same learned encoder, every reset-completed decoder Kraus operator, same post-training bath and fixed U0. Pass plus fail is TP and F=(2/3)W holds as a bath-operator identity. The guard uses C=1.5,s=.4,t=6,b=0 with universal accepted-subnormalized soundness 1/128; the smaller simulated tail is not this theorem.

requires: Private uniform matching on n=2m>=4 and one role-independent complete CPTP operation on the same boundary
